# Security policy

Homebase Hub is maintained by [@Jackpison](https://github.com/Jackpison).

## Reporting a problem

[Open an issue](https://github.com/Jackpison/Homebase-Hub/issues/new/choose) and say which version you use (Settings > Changelog) and how to see the problem. GitHub's **Security > Report a vulnerability** works too, when it is switched on.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets fixes. Install it from **Settings > Updates**.
